question: Which body part helps us to hear?
funFact: Our ears also help us keep our balance!

question: Which sense organ helps us to smell?
funFact: Our nose can remember about 50,000 different smells!

question: Which sense organ helps us to taste food?
funFact: Our tongue has thousands of tiny taste buds.

question: Which sense organ helps us to feel hot and cold?
funFact: Skin is the biggest organ of our body!

question: Which organ helps us to think and remember?
funFact: The brain is protected by a hard bone called the skull.

question: Where does the food go after we swallow it?
funFact: The stomach mixes food with juices to break it down.

question: How many teeth does an adult have?
funFact: Children have 20 milk teeth, which fall out one by one!

question: How many milk teeth does a child have?
funFact: Milk teeth start falling out at about 6 years of age.

question: What is the hard frame inside our body called?
funFact: An adult skeleton has 206 bones!

question: Which bone protects our brain?
funFact: The skull is made of many bones joined together.

question: Which bones protect our heart and lungs?
funFact: The ribs form a cage around the heart and lungs.

question: How many fingers do we have on both hands together?
funFact: Our thumb helps us hold things tightly.

question: Which part joins our head to our body?
funFact: The neck lets us turn our head left and right.

question: Which joint helps us bend our arm?
funFact: Try to lick your elbow — it is almost impossible!

question: Which joint helps us bend our leg?
funFact: The knee is the biggest joint in our body.

question: What do we breathe out?
funFact: Plants take in the carbon dioxide we breathe out!

question: What carries blood all over our body?
funFact: Our heart pushes blood through the blood vessels.

question: Which body part helps us to walk and run?
funFact: Our legs have the longest bones in the body.

question: Which bones run down our back and help us stand straight?
funFact: The backbone is made of 33 small bones stacked together.

question: Which part of the eye is coloured black, brown, blue or green?
funFact: No two people have exactly the same iris!

question: What protects our eyes from dust?
funFact: We blink about 15 times every minute.

question: Which body part do we use to chew our food?
funFact: Chewing food well helps our stomach digest it.

question: Where is our heart located?
funFact: Your heart is about the size of your fist!

question: What do our muscles help us do?
funFact: We use about 17 muscles when we smile!

question: Which body part gives us our fingerprints?
funFact: Every person's fingerprints are different, even twins!
